```{.r .cell-code}
ds_US_names <- readxl::read_excel('us_policies.xlsx', n_max = 2, col_names = FALSE) |> 
  t() |> 
  tibble::as_tibble(.name_repair = "unique_quiet") |> 
  tidyr::fill("...1") |> 
  tidyr::unite(col = "new_names", "...1", "...2", sep = "_") |> 
  dplyr::pull() |> 
  stringr::str_remove_all("_NA") |>
  janitor::make_clean_names()
  
ds_US_raw <- readxl::read_excel('us_policies.xlsx', col_names = ds_US_names, skip = 2)
```
